2/ Where does each model fail?

Trump called the U.S.-Venezuela oil pact the "biggest oil deal in the world." Energy experts, economists, and lawyers are much less sure.

The deal was negotiated in secret, with no competitive bidding, and the contract still hasn't been released. U.S. officials have not publicly named which companies will operate the 17 fields.

It was signed with Venezuela's interim president. She says the term is 25 years; U.S. officials, meanwhile, have talked about century-long rights. Legal experts say her authority to lock the country into a deal this large can be challenged later.

Economists say the tax take Caracas advertised looks unusually low. The infrastructure is wrecked and needs huge repairs before output rises in a meaningful way. Most of the barrels are extra-heavy Orinoco crude, among the hardest oils to produce and refine at scale.

Columbia energy scholar Luisa Palacios put the risk this way: if the goal was to make Venezuela investable, this structure may do the opposite by weakening an already fragile legal framework.

Lower pump prices? Don't count on it anytime soon.

Sources: Reuters, NPR

I’ve spent 21 years writing about why the economy stopped working for ordinary people.

It’s not that they didn’t work hard enough, or save enough, or follow the rules. The system was rigged against them by debt and demographics, decades before most of them were even born. 

After years of chipping away at why the whole machine behaved the way it did, it all collapsed into one thing. I called it the Everything Code, because it literally explains everything… why house prices and wages stopped making any sense, why asset prices keep climbing while you keep getting poorer, why your money buys less of your future every year, why politics is so fractured and none of the old rules work anymore…

But that’s only the diagnosis. The real story is what comes next. We’re standing at the dawn of the Exponential Age, and it’ll either crush people or set them free, depending on whether they can see it coming.

Now, for the first time, all of this thinking is in one place. My first book The Everything Code is out Nov 3rd.
